content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Regulated electric generation and distribution utility serving customers over owned networks; telecom lines differ, but the core electric utility business matches."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Fire protection and building contracting services for buildings, not utility energy delivery over owned networks."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Regulated water and wastewater utility; similar utility model but delivers water, not electricity, gas or steam."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced construction and maintenance contractor working on utility networks, not an owner-operator selling delivery service."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Regulated natural gas and electric distribution utility earning rates on owned networks, closely matching the target's core delivery business."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Propane retail distribution and appliance service to households, not a regulated network utility."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Water and sewer utility with recycled water sales; different product and networks from energy delivery."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Electrical contracting and building systems installation for customers, not operating a regulated energy delivery network."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Building mechanical, electrical and plumbing services for building owners; a service contractor, not a utility."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Regulated water and wastewater utility plus contract operations; different product from electric, gas and steam delivery."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Fiber internet, phone and video provider to households; a telecom business rather than energy delivery."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Propane and heating oil distributor delivering fuel by truck to customers, not a regulated pipeline or network utility."}]}
